response.reason: The kernel drops the residual entirely, but each bias is only 0.75*sum|W[j]|, so inputs aligned with a row's sign pattern (e.g. x = sign(W[j]) or x = center) yield dot(W[j],x) = sum|W[j]| and a ReLU output of 0.25*sum|W[j]|, contributing up to 0.0625*sum|W[j]| (~0.375-0.75) per neuron; with several rows sharing the mostly-common center sign pattern, the total residual exceeds the 1.0 tolerance. The smoke probe missed this because random/axis samples rarely exceed the 0.75*sum|W| threshold.
